spec.goal: I can handle shopping and café conversations about food and plans and follow simple announcements.

topics.title: Role-Play: Shopping for Clothes or Groceries
topics.covers: Practice buying items, asking prices, sizes, and quantities, and responding to a clerk with a partner.

topics.title: Speaking: A Five-Minute Café Chat About Food and Plans
topics.covers: Hold a relaxed café conversation combining ordering, likes, and plans with quiero, me gusta, and voy a.

topics.title: Markets, Bargaining, and Shopping Culture
topics.covers: Compare supermarkets, mercados, tianguis, and tiendas de abarrotes, and use polite bargaining phrases like ¿Cuánto es lo menos?

topics.title: Listening: Restaurant and Store Announcements
topics.covers: Listen for prices, times, and items in announcements, orders, and store dialogues at natural speed.

topics.title: Reading: Menus, Ads, and Receipts
topics.covers: Read authentic menus, store ads, and receipts and pull out prices, items, hours, and offers.

spec.convo: You and the partner meet at a café, each holding a different schedule, and plan a day of shopping.

What do you want to have?

scene.title: En el café: planes de compras

lines.es: Son las diez de la mañana. Mara y Tomás están en un café.
lines.en: It's ten in the morning. Mara and Tomás are at a café.
Hi, Tomás! What do you want to drink?

lines.es: Quiero un jugo de naranja. ¿Y tú?
lines.en: I want an orange juice. And you?

lines.es: Me gusta el café con leche.
Voy a ir de compras el sábado. ¿Vamos juntos?
lines.en: I'm going to go shopping on Saturday. Shall we go together?
Yes! I'm looking for some shoes.

lines.es: Hoy hay una oferta especial. La tienda cierra a las nueve.
lines.en: Today there's a special offer. The store closes at nine.

lines.es: Perfecto. Compro fruta en el mercado y zapatos en la tienda.
lines.en: Perfect. I'll buy fruit at the market and shoes at the store.

questions.question: What is Tomás going to do on Saturday?
What time does the store close?

convo.setting: A café in the morning. You and Tomás are each holding a different schedule, and you plan a day of shopping together.
convo.learnerCard: You meet Tomás at a café. Order something, say what you like, say what you're going to buy, and ask a price. Then plan a day of shopping.
convo.learnerCardEs: Estás en el café con Tomás. Pide algo, di qué te gusta y planea un día de compras.
convo.partnerCard: Tomás has a café and a free Saturday. He wants to go shopping with you and loves a good offer.

goals.text: Say what you're going to buy (Voy a comprar…)
Ask the price of something (¿Cuánto cuesta…?)

targets: Me gusta el café con leche.

script.reply: ¡Buenísimo! Yo quiero un café con leche.
A mí también me gusta el pan dulce.
script.hint: Say "Me gusta el café con leche."

script.reply: ¡Qué bien! Yo voy a comprar zapatos el sábado.
Cuesta ocho dólares. ¡Es una oferta especial!

convo.closing: ¡Perfecto! Nos vemos el sábado en el mercado. ¡Adiós!

choices: Voy a la tienda a las nueve.
La tienda cierra a las nueve.

chats.es: Voy a ir de compras el sábado. ¿Vienes?

reads.passage: OFERTA: Camisetas a diez dólares. Zapatos a veinte dólares. La tienda está abierta de nueve a seis.
reads.question: How much are the T-shirts?

reads.passage: MENÚ DEL DÍA: sopa, pollo con arroz y jugo de naranja. Cuesta ocho dólares. Abierto de once a tres.
reads.question: How much does the menu of the day cost?
